decisions.reason: The quote directly describes a patient's clinical presentation. The abstract establishes that this patient 'presented with progressive psychomotor regression, dysmorphic facial features, myoclonus, and vision loss' and is identified as having CLN14 (caused by KCTD7 variants). The patient 'developed his first generalized tonic-clonic seizure' at age 18 months. The grammatical subject of the sentence is the patient (who has CLN14), making generalized tonic-clonic seizure a phenotype of CLN14. This is a clinical manifestation of the disease in the affected individual.

The quoted sentence explicitly states 'WES identified a novel homozygous variant c.413T > C, p.(Leu138Pro) in the KCTD7 gene'. This directly and unambiguously associates the genetic variant with the KCTD7 gene. The variant is found 'in the KCTD7 gene', establishing the association clearly.
